DiagnosticGetSource.description: One explicit exact diagnostic record source.

DiagnosticSection.description: Source-supported diagnostic sections; no all section.
x-enum-descriptions: GTR native gene rows; five per page.
GTR native condition rows; five per page.
GTR native method entries; five per page.
FDA SSED PDF text: 25 MiB, 100 pages and 6144 escaped bytes per fragment; scans without text are explicit.
Selected PMA submission statement; one fragment per page.
PMA base application supplement headers; five per page.

PmaSupplement.description: Explicit native PMA supplement selector; no invented base alias.

Text.description: Bounded nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

description: Get one exact source record or supported section. A listing is not authorization; a companion row is not a treatment recommendation.

bundle_revision.description: Immutable stored bundle revision retained by a continuation.

id.description: Exact native identity, including version for GTR.

section.description:
GTR: genes, conditions, methods. PMA: regulatory, supplements, summary.
WHO, 510(k) and device recalls have no sections; omit for the card.

section_limit.description: Maximum native rows; omitted means five rows, or one regulatory fragment.

section_offset.description: Zero-based native row or fragment offset.

source.description:
Explicit source: GTR accession/version, WHO Product ID, PMA P number,
510(k) K number or device recall Z-NNNN-YYYY.

supplement.description: Exact native PMA supplement; absent selects the base row.
